title: Circuit-breaker trip across a restart

options.name: Keep current behaviour: a restart clears the trip and its history
options.risk: A misfiring detector gets `threshold` more emergency sells after every restart, and the operator is not told at boot that a chain had tripped (AUD-ANTIRUG-010).

options.name: Persist the trip and the trigger events; restore them at boot; only the dashboard reset clears them
options.behavior_impact: A tripped chain stays halted across restarts until acknowledged.
options.risk: A trip caused by the dispatch counting (AUD-ANTIRUG-003) keeps anti-rug off after a restart until the operator acts.

options.name: persist-trip, plus a Telegram alert at boot for every chain that starts tripped
options.behavior_impact: As persist-trip, and the operator is told at once.

recommendation: persist-and-alert, together with ANTIRUG-01 so that a trip means several real triggers.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract).
behavior_impact: Decides whether a breaker trip survives a restart.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
